stem.text: Which statement about the blood flow in the cardiac cycle is correct?

A.text: Blood flows into the aorta through the semilunar valve due to contraction of the right ventricle.

B.text: Blood flows into the left atrium through the pulmonary artery when the wall of the left atrium relaxes.

C.text: Blood flows into the right atrium through the vena cava when the wall of the right atrium relaxes.

D.text: Blood flows into the right ventricle through the semilunar valve due to contraction of the right atrium.
